notes: The FCC ID is listed for models ES1, ES2 and ES4.

gaps: Neither page states the battery cell chemistry or cell count, so the battery_li slot here is the catalogue's battery part, not a stated chemistry.
Ninebot's online ES-series spec table lists a different nominal motor power for the ES2, so treat 250 W with caution.
method: The ManualsLib page titled Ninebot ES2 Manual (a third-party copy; its Specifications table has a single column headed ES2) backs every part below.
The ManualsLib page for the Segway Ninebot KickScooter ES series manual (Certifications, page 11) lists FCC ID 2ALS8-NT9527 and IC 22636-NT9527 for model ES1/ES2/ES4.
The 250 W motor figure is the max-power value printed in that ES2 manual copy only.
Qty, ext and obs ratings are editorial, not source facts.

comps.spec: The manual's warnings refer to a hub motor (it can be hot after riding). Specifications table: Max. Power 250 W, the only motor row; nominal power is not listed. Brushless type and motor count not stated.

Specifications table: Nominal Voltage 36 VDC; Nominal Capacity 187 Wh; Max. Charging Voltage 42 VDC; Number of Batteries 1 (a footnote says a second pack can be installed, which changes some parameters). Cell chemistry and cell count not stated.
Specifications table row 'Battery Management System': over-heating, short circuit, over-current and over-charge protection. Board or IC part number not stated.

Specifications table: Input Voltage 100-240 VAC; Output Voltage 42 VDC; Output Current 1.7 A; Output Power 71 W; Duration of Charging 3.5 h. Charging section: the LED on the charger changes from red (charging) to green (trickle charge).
Headlight: when the scooter is powered on, a single click turns the headlight on or off. LED or bulb type not stated.
Brake light: Features table lists 'Brake Light' as 'LED rear light'.
comps.loc: rear of the scooter; exact position not stated

comps.spec: Dashboard display: speedometer shows current speed and error codes when faults are detected; battery indicator is 5 bars, each about 20% power; Bluetooth icon blinks when ready to connect and stays solid when connected to a mobile device.
comps.loc: dashboard (Product Overview); exact position not stated
